title: Pasted clipboard images are written to a guessable world-readable temp file that is never deleted
trigger: Paste an image into the composer (or export a peer QR through the same helper), send or discard it, keep using Quill.
effect: The image bytes stay in the system temp dir as quill-paste-<nanos>-<seq>-<pid>.<ext> (default umask, usually readable by other local users) until the OS clears temp; the startup sweep in scratch.rs only covers the quill-send-photos/quill-edits... subfolders, not these files. A guessable name in a shared temp dir is also open to a pre-placed symlink.
fix: Write into the swept per-process work dir (scratch) with create_new and mode 0600, and delete the file when the tray entry is sent, removed or the app exits.

title: A failed draft send leaves the slot marked dirty with nothing pending
trigger: Type in the composer; the debounced or flushed setChatDraftMessage send returns Err
effect: mark_draft_dirty ran, pending_draft/draft_clock were cleared before send_draft (Write arm line 117-119, commit_debounced_draft take()), the error is returned and dropped by callers; the slot stays dirty so drafts saved from other devices are ignored (per the deselect_chat comment) and the draft is never retried
fix: Keep the pending draft until send_draft succeeds (Draft stage: Clean, Dirty, Debouncing{token}, Sending).

title: status_open / chat_status_open are only cleared by the media panel mode setter on the current account
trigger: Open the emoji-status selector, then switch accounts (or lose the panel) without leaving Status mode through set_media_panel_mode.
effect: The old session keeps status_open=true, so every ingest of that background account keeps resolving status emoji (getCustomEmojiStickers) and a later failure writes status_note.
fix: Move the open flag into OnScreen/WindowSlot state and close it in the Farewell.

title: load_message_effects marks an id requested before the send; a failed send or dropped answer leaves it requested forever
trigger: Open a chat with effect messages while the JSON sender fails (channel closed during a reconnect) or the request is dropped without an answer or error; mark_requested(effect_id) already ran and the `?` on send_json_request returns early.
effect: wanted() filters on `requested`, so that effect and the ids after it in the loop are never asked for again: no badge icon, no effect, and the send-menu picker cell never loads, until restart.
fix: Make `requested` part of a per-id Fetch stage set only after the send succeeded, and leave Loading on the error arm, a dropped request and a reconnect.

title: AI text answers go through one single-slot Option and replace whatever the draft is now
trigger: Press Fix with AI, keep typing (or start another AI action in a second chat window) before the answer lands
effect: MessagesState::ai_composer_text (core/mod.rs:793) holds one (chat, text): a second answer overwrites the first, the answer replaces the newer draft, and an answer for a chat whose window closed stays forever (window_upkeep.rs:229 only takes it when ours)
fix: Carry a draft revision/token (as AiComposePurpose::BoxCompose{token} does) and queue answers per chat

title: Deferred caption: row is rewritten to the new caption and the edit error is discarded
trigger: Edit the caption of a pending upload, then the send succeeds and editMessageCaption fails to send (or is refused)
effect: set_caption mutates the local row first and `let _ = self.edit_snapshot` drops the Err: the row shows a caption the server never got. Also an entry in deferred_captions whose message disappears without a send outcome (chat deleted, account state reset) is never removed
fix: Keep the old caption on the pending record and restore it (with a toast) when the edit fails; drop entries when the message leaves history

title: begin_bot_edit leaves a half-started edit when the second load send fails
trigger: Open the bot edit dialog while the sender refuses between the name and about requests (or the first fails).
effect: edit is already Some with loads holding RequestIds that never get answers (send_json_request ? returns early); the dialog keeps waiting for texts and the about request is never sent.
fix: Edit stage enum Loading{waiting}/Ready/Failed, set after both sends, with Failed on the Err arm.

title: stop_poll looks the poll up in histories only, while the other poll calls use loaded_message
trigger: Stop an own poll from a forum topic or comment thread view where the poll is not in the main history.
effect: stop_poll returns InvalidRequest (can_stop false) because histories.get(chat).messages has no such row; send_poll_answer, retract_poll_vote and fetch_poll_voters use session.loaded_message, which also searches topic histories and saved views.
fix: Use session.loaded_message in stop_poll.

title: send_quick_reply has no in-flight dedupe, so a double tap sends the shortcut's messages twice
trigger: Pick a quick reply for a customer chat and double click.
effect: Each call allocates a new sending_id and sends sendQuickReplyShortcutMessages; the same messages arrive twice in the chat. Also add_quick_reply_text (line 76) and delete/rename have no dedupe: a double click on Add creates the message twice.
fix: A Sending stage per (chat, shortcut) and a Mutating stage that disables the buttons.

title: sticker_categories_asked is set before the request and reset only when the send fails; an error answer leaves it true
trigger: Open the sticker panel while getEmojiCategories fails (error response).
effect: No error handler resets the flag, fetch_sticker_categories returns early for the whole session, and the category strip stays empty until restart.
fix: enum CategoriesFetch { Idle, Asking{request}, Loaded, Failed } reset by the error path.

title: advance_manager_commit clears the whole commit queue on a send error, so queued removals and reorders are silently lost after the box has closed
trigger: Close the stickers manager box after removing sets and reordering; the second step's send fails.
effect: All later commits are dropped; the box already closed as if saved, the order/removal never reaches the server.
fix: Keep failed commits in the queue as Failed with a visible retry, drop only the failed step.

title: One shared stickers.failed flag is cleared by every sticker_request start and set by any failure
trigger: Open the sticker panel; a getTrendingStickerSets fails; another list request starts.
effect: The next request sets failed=false, hiding the earlier failure; a failure of an unrelated request marks the visible tab failed.
fix: A per-list fetch enum (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of shared failed/loading_* bools.

title: refresh_stale_panels takes the recent/favorites/trending/emoji/reaction stale flags first, then returns early on an inactive path or on the first send error
trigger: updateRecentStickers arrives while locked or while the first refetch's send fails.
effect: The remaining stale flags are already cleared, so those panels stay out of date until another update arrives.
fix: Clear each stale flag only when its refetch is sent.

title: status_open stays set after an account switch with the status picker open
trigger: Open the emoji status picker (Premium status), switch account without closing it
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole, so pickers.media_panel.panel_mode resets without set_media_panel_mode, and PickerUi's Farewell is empty (ui/pickers_state.rs:107); close_emoji_status_choices is never called for the retired account. Its Session keeps status_open=true in the background, so every envelope of that hidden client runs maybe_resolve_emoji_status_choices and keeps resolving status choices; on switch back the flag is set with the picker closed
fix: Add a Farewell for the media panel that calls close_emoji_status_choices, or derive 'resolving statuses' from the panel mode instead of a Session flag

title: Any getMessageEffect error (rate limit, network, timeout) marks the effect gone for the whole session
trigger: Open a private chat that has messages sent with effects while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers 429 to getMessageEffect; the error arm in state/domains/stickers/error.rs:21 calls MessageEffects::fail(id) for every TdError without looking at the code.
effect: The effect id sits in `failed` for the life of the Session: wanted() never asks again, is_gone() makes message_effects_pass drop the waiting play, the badge never gets its icon and the effect never plays, until the account is re-added. The message was already marked watched, so it is lost for good.
fix: Hold each effect as Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle, loading, ready, failed) where only a real not-found is a terminal Gone and other errors return to idle so the next frame can ask again.

title: A failed game button press (GetCallbackQueryAnswerGame) gives no feedback
trigger: Press a game button in a bot chat while the bot does not answer (TDLib 502) or offline
effect: Nothing happens: apply_bots_error notes an answer for GetCallbackQueryAnswer and ...WithPassword only, the Game purpose falls to the default arm
fix: Handle the Game purpose in the same arm as the plain callback

title: A failed getSharingProtection turns private-chat sharing protection off without the confirm box
trigger: Profile menu of a private chat: Enable Sharing, while getMessageProperties fails (offline blip, TDLib error)
effect: The error arm sets private_sharing.enable = TurnOff(chat_id) unconditionally, so the driver proceeds to turn protection off; if the other person protects the chat TDLib sends them a request the user never confirmed (AskToRequest is skipped). Also not checked that the flow is still for chat_id
fix: On error go to a Failed/Unknown stage that shows the Send Request? box (or an error), never to TurnOff.

title: One session-wide slot for message_menu_actions is shared by every window and every consumer, and a failed getMessageProperties has no error arm
trigger: Open a message context menu in a chat window while the main window hovers a shared-media row (shared_media_select.rs) or the media viewer fetches actions; or getMessageProperties fails
effect: The slot holds one (chat,message); the other consumer's fetch overwrites it, the menu falls back to the permissive local guess (allows(local,..) in message_menu_overlay.rs) and may offer Delete/Edit rows TDLib would refuse. On error (error.rs has no GetMessageMenuActions arm) the menu stays on the guess for good
fix: Key actions by (ChatId,MessageId) in a map owned by the consumer (per window) and add a Failed state that hides gated rows.

title: One-shot error notes are single Option<String> slots overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two message actions fail (for example resend and delete-by-sender, or two poll option edits) between two UI drains, or a failure lands while the main window is hidden or locked
effect: The first note is replaced and never shown; a lost toast. Writers: error.rs lines 69, 75, 81, 87, 124-143, 188-211 all assign Some(..) over any undrained value
fix: A Notes queue (Vec<Note>) drained whole, or push to the shared toast queue directly.

title: AI composer answer is matched only by chat id, not by draft, topic or request
trigger: Ask AI to fix text in a forum chat topic A, switch to topic B of the same chat (or type more text), the answer arrives
effect: window_upkeep.rs:229-246 applies the answer to the composer of open_chat==chat_id and set_composer_markup replaces the whole draft: it overwrites topic B's draft or text typed after the request. A second answer overwrites the first undrained slot
fix: Carry (RequestId, DraftKey incl. topic, draft revision) in the answer and apply only when the composer still shows that key and revision.

title: One shared StickerPanel::failed flag is set by 11 unrelated sticker requests
trigger: Open the sticker panel with loaded sets, then fail a favorite add/remove, clear recent, or a search request.
effect: stickers.failed = true turns the loaded panel into the failure state although the shown list is fine; it clears only on the next successful load.
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> stages; a failed mutation reports a note, not the list failure.

title: createForumTopic drops the cached topic list but forum_row_asked stays set
trigger: Create a topic in a forum that the chat list preloaded (forum_row_asked has the chat). The ForumTopic answer removes forum_topics for the chat.
effect: preload_topics (connect/subsection_tabs.rs:97) never asks again for the chat, so its chat-list row reads loaded = false ('Loading...') until the forum is opened.
fix: Per-forum enum TopicsFetch { Idle, Loading, Ready(list), Failed } so removing the list also leaves Asked.

title: A forced reply arms only the main window; one aimed at a chat window's chat is lost, and a second in the same poll batch overwrites the first
trigger: Open a bot chat in its own window; the bot sends a message with force-reply markup (or two bots do in one batch). The poll drains Session::bots::pending_force_reply once in the main window (ui/notifications/mod.rs drain_force_reply, commented 'not routed there yet').
effect: The chat window's composer is not put into reply mode; the force-reply of another chat is dropped by the single Option slot.
fix: Keep force-reply targets per chat (or in the chat's ChatUi/WindowSlot) and drain them in per_window_upkeep of whichever window shows the chat.

title: Report flow answers are matched by chat only, so an answer for a closed flow applies to a new flow in the same chat
trigger: Report message A (choose a reason so the flow is Sending), press Esc (clear_message_report), open Report on message B in the same chat before TDLib answers. The old reportChat answers Ok.
effect: accept_message_report matches pending.chat_id only (ReportMessages carries no flow identity), so B's flow becomes Reported although B was never sent; an old error likewise turns the new flow into Failed.
fix: Give each flow an id (or store the in-flight RequestId in Checking/Sending) and apply an answer or error only when it matches; clearing the flow drops the id.

title: Any getRepliedMessage error marks the reply 'Deleted message' for good
trigger: Open a chat with a reply whose original is outside the window while the network drops or TDLib answers 429/500 (error arm messages/error.rs:19 calls reject_replied_message unconditionally).
effect: ReplyTarget::Missing is stored, reply_fetch_candidates skips every key that is in reply_targets, and reply_header reports ReplyState::Deleted with 'Deleted message' until the chat is pruned; the strip is never refetched although the message exists.
fix: Only 400/404 produce Missing; other errors remove the Loading entry (or store Failed{retry_at}) so the pass asks again after a wait, as GetStory does with story_retry.

title: accept_sticker_set clears loading_set for an answer that is not the selected set
trigger: In the sticker panel select set A, then select set B before A answers (select_sticker_set resets loading_set and maybe_load_selected_sticker_set is skipped because a GetStickerSet is in flight).
effect: A's answer sets loading_set=false and is then discarded (selected is B); B has no request, loaded_set_id is None, so the panel shows an empty grid with no spinner until the next per-update pass resends. If A's request fails, panel.failed=true is shown for B.
fix: StickerPanel.set: enum { Idle, Loading{request,set_id}, Ready{set_id,stickers}, Failed{set_id} }; apply and fail only when request id matches and clear loading only for it.

title: resendMessages always sends paid_message_star_count 0 and goes around the paid-message guard
trigger: In a chat that charges Stars per message, a send fails with a retryable state (for example the price went up: messageSendingStateFailed.required_paid_message_star_count > 0). Right-click the failed message and choose Retry send.
effect: resend_failed_message (connect/messages/edit.rs:266) builds resendMessages with paid_message_star_count 0. PaidGuard::screen only looks at '"@type":"send' and 'forwardM', so 'resendMessages' is never priced or confirmed. In a paid chat the retry fails again every time, and nothing asks the user to pay.
fix: Put resendMessages through the paid guard (count = message_ids.len()) or pass the failed state's required_paid_message_star_count after a confirmation.

title: Send To switch stats the Send To folder on the UI thread every render, and concurrent toggles can finish out of order
trigger: Windows: open Settings > General (rendered each frame calls is_enabled -> SHGetKnownFolderPath + is_file); click the switch twice quickly (two background_spawn set_enabled tasks)
effect: per-frame blocking shell/disk IO on the UI thread while the page is open; the two background tasks can finish in either order so the shortcut ends in the state of the first click, not the last
fix: Read once into a Fetch<bool>/enum {Known(bool), Applying{want}, Failed} on the settings screen; refuse or queue a click while Applying.

title: Cancel while 'Creating...' loses the result of a createBot that then succeeds
trigger: Press Create, then Cancel (button stays enabled while submitted) before TDLib answers
effect: close_bot_create takes the dialog and reset_create_bot bumps CreateBotState::generation and clears creating; the late createBot answer no longer matches creating==Some(generation) (state/domains/bots/owned.rs:apply_created_bot), so the bot is created on the server but the user gets no toast, no chat and no share_users_with_bot for a keyboard-button request; retrying the same username then says taken
fix: Disable Cancel (or keep a Creating stage that outlives the box) so the answer still reports and shares the new bot

title: START parameter is removed before TDLib confirms sendBotStartMessage
trigger: Open a bot via t.me/bot?start=param, press Start while the request will fail (flood, offline right after send)
effect: press_bot_start removes Session bots.bot_start_params[chat] as soon as the request is queued; the error arm only sets chat_action_error, so the Start bar and the parameter are gone and the bot is later started without the parameter or not at all
fix: Remove the parameter in the reducer on the sendBotStartMessage success (or keep a Starting{param} stage restored on error)

title: Add-bot and Share-game boxes close as if saved when the request was only queued
trigger: Profile of a bot > Add to group > pick chat > Add as admin, when the server later refuses (no right) ; or share a game to a chat the bot cannot post in.
effect: submit_add_bot/send_shared_game return true on Ok(Some)/Ok(_) (request queued), so the box closes and the chat is selected; the refusal only arrives later as a generic error. For Plan::Admin the start message is also sent right after the promote without waiting for its answer.
fix: Keep the box in a Sending stage and close on the answer matched by request id; send the start payload on promote ok.
